name: Trading 212
limits: Safety: the skill defaults to the LIVE (real-money) environment. If T212_ENV is not set it uses live.trading212.com, so set T212_ENV=demo and use an API key created in your demo (practice) account before testing. API keys only work in the environment they were created in. Official open-source Agent Skill (trading212-labs/agent-skills) wrapping the Public API (beta, v0): market, limit, stop and stop-limit orders, portfolio, history. API key + secret; demo and live environments; optional IP allow-list for keys. Invest and Stocks ISA accounts only. No per-order confirmation or caps documented. Trading 212's API Terms prohibit using the API for Algorithmic Trading (orders determined by an algorithm with limited or no human intervention).
limits_es: Seguridad: la skill usa por defecto el entorno REAL (dinero real). Si no defines T212_ENV, usa live.trading212.com; define T212_ENV=demo y usa una clave API creada en tu cuenta demo (práctica) antes de hacer pruebas. Cada clave API solo funciona en el entorno en el que se creó. Skill oficial de código abierto (trading212-labs/agent-skills) sobre la API pública (beta, v0): órdenes de mercado, limitadas, stop y stop-limit, cartera e historial. Clave y secreto API; entornos demo y real; lista opcional de IP permitidas. Solo cuentas Invest y Stocks ISA. No documenta confirmación por orden ni topes. Las condiciones de la API de Trading 212 prohíben usarla para trading algorítmico (órdenes decididas por un algoritmo con poca o ninguna intervención humana).
notes: Announced 4 Feb 2026 by Trading 212 staff in its official community ('What's new'); the GitHub org trading212-labs links to trading212.com. Works with AgentSkills-compatible tools (Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Cursor); no MCP server and no ChatGPT/Claude.ai app. Spain is served by Trading 212 EU GmbH (BaFin); the skill's own country list is not published. MCP servers for Trading 212 remain community projects. Live-by-default: the skill's README and SKILL.md (checked 19 Oct 2026) say T212_ENV is optional and defaults to "live"; the SKILL.md also tells the agent to ask whether you want LIVE or DEMO before making API calls.
notes_es: Anunciado el 4 feb 2026 por personal de Trading 212 en su comunidad oficial («What's new»); la organización de GitHub trading212-labs enlaza a trading212.com.
